title: Layered Stuff
description: Player skin layers but for blocks.
body:
❗Requires [Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts)

Layered Stuff

This pack changes models to have an extra layer over/into some blocks that follow their textures. It is similar to 3D blocks resource packs except this adds flat cubes instead of ugly micro-voxels. ### Layered Models: - **Layered Anvils** - **Layered Barrel** - **Layered Beds** - **Layered Bookshelf** - **Layered Chiseled Bookshelves** - **Layered Crafter** - **Layered Dispenser** - **Layered Dropper** - **Layered End Portal** - **Layered Jukebox** - **Layered Shelf** - **Layered Furnaces** - **Layered Carved Pumpkins and Jack o' Lanterns** - **Layered Lanterns** - **Layered Leaves** - **Layered Ladders** - **Layered Rails** - **Layered Respawn Anchor** - **Layered Bricks** (every brick type can be customised separately) ### Other Models: - **Backfaced Doors** - **Backfaced Trapdoors** - **Clear Redstone** (rises redstone dust so it stands above the layer of layered blocks) - **Square Grass** #### Compability This pack doesn't add any textures, meaning it can work with most other resource packs. If a model isn't showing properly, check if it's enabled in the Respackopts configs or make sure this resource pack is above everything else. ---
